turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you catch that bug report I filed for the model loader? GitHub issue #38606.
Not yet, I'll take a look. What's the status on it?
I just closed it. The dev team said it was a duplicate of an older ticket, so no need to keep it open.
Got it. I'll note that it's resolved as a duplicate.
Yeah, that's right. Anyway, did you order the new mechanical keyboard switches?
Yes, the linear reds are shipped and should arrive Thursday.
Perfect. Also, is it going to rain tomorrow? I want to know if I should walk to the office.
It looks dry for the morning, but there's a 40% chance of showers after 2 PM.
Okay, I'll bring an umbrella just in case.
Lloyd, I need to prep for the sprint review. Did you see the update on that LoRA bug?
Which one are you referring to?
GitHub issue #38606. It's not a duplicate after all. The QA team reopened it because they found actual KV block corruption under rapid LoRA alternation.
That's a significant finding. So it's active now?
Yes, it remains open. We need to prioritize the memory leak investigation.
Understood. I'll flag it as high priority in your notes.
Thanks. By the way, did you try that new ramen place on 5th?
I don't eat, but I heard the tonkotsu broth is highly rated.
Haha, true. I went yesterday and it was amazing.
